The <b>{{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}}</b> is a piece of equipment which, unlike most other tools, does not degrade with use. It's one of three fishing rods found in-game, any of which is required for [[fishing]]. It is provided by the [[Lighthouse Keeper]], either after the player delivers six(6) [[moth]]s, or sold as a Tier I item for {{Money|200}}. It cannot be acquired through any other means, such as crafting, nor can it be studied.

Compared to the other fishing rods, this fishing rod is essentially the "starter rod", with the worst efficiency and fish-availability. However, it may be preferred when fishing specifically for lower-tiers of fish, such as fish-bait, as it will prevent most competition.

==See Also==
*{{Item|Good fishing rod}} - the Tier II rod, serving as an upgraded 'Simple' in most cases.
*{{Item|Excellent fishing rod}} - the Tier III rod, specifically designed for higher-tier fish.
